name: stick
description: Build and edit a Stick link-in-bio or landing page from chat, saved as a draft you publish in Stick.

interface.longDescription:
Stick builds one-page sites made for phones, from a link in bio to a landing page. Connect your Stick account and ChatGPT can make your page and change it, with the same blocks and themes as Stick's editor.

Ask ChatGPT to:
- Make a page for your business, portfolio or creator profile: a profile header, links, social icons, text, photo galleries, features, FAQs, a map, a form, embedded videos, music and posts, and Digital Product blocks.
- Restyle a page: theme, colours, font and background.
- Add, rewrite, reorder or remove sections.
- Add your own photos through an upload card in the chat, and crop them.
- Add animated GIPHY stickers.

For creators, freelancers, small businesses and anyone who needs a page for their link in bio.

ChatGPT saves drafts and never publishes: you review the page and publish it in Stick's editor. It can't unpublish or delete a site, read analytics, contacts, form submissions or orders, connect Stripe, take payments, or upload the file a Digital Product delivers. An account has one site, and a site has one page.
capabilities: Create a link-in-bio or landing page as a draft
Restyle a page: theme, colours, font and background
Add, rewrite, reorder and remove blocks
Upload your photos from the chat and crop them
Add free and paid Digital Product blocks
defaultPrompt: Use Stick to list my sites.
Make a link in bio for my ceramics studio: the shop, workshop dates and my Instagram.
Make my Stick page darker with a serif font, and keep my text.

positive.prompt: Use Stick to list my sites.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's site with its name, status (published, unpublished or with unpublished changes) and links to its editor, Analytics and Audience. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: What's on my Stick page right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the draft's theme, font, background and blocks from top to bottom, matching what Stick's editor shows. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Restyle the page and keep its content
positive.prompt: Make my Stick page darker with a serif font, and keep all my text and links.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new draft with a dark background and a serif font. Every block's text and links stay as they were. The answer gives the editor link and says the change is a draft that isn't published.

positive.prompt: Add my Instagram https://www.instagram.com/stickdemo and my YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@stickdemo to my Stick page.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a new draft with both addresses linked on the page and the rest of the page unchanged. The answer gives the editor link and says nothing was published.

positive.prompt: Add a couple of animated coffee stickers to my Stick page.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds coffee stickers on GIPHY and saves a new draft with two of them on the page. The answer gives the editor link and says nothing was published.

negative.description: Publishing is out of scope: no tool publishes, and the page must not be described as live. Expected: says the page is published in Stick's editor and gives the editor link.

Reading analytics or orders is out of scope: no tool reads visitors, contacts, form submissions or orders. Expected: says it can't see them, invents no numbers, and may give the site's Analytics link from list_sites.
negative.prompt: How many visitors and orders did my Stick page get this week?

negative.description: Deleting a site is out of scope: no tool deletes one. Expected: declines, changes nothing and says it can't delete sites.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments happen in ChatGPT. ChatGPT can add a Digital Product block with a price to a draft page; selling starts only after the owner connects Stripe in Stick and publishes the page there.

publication.release_notes: First release: build and edit a Stick page as a draft, with themes, blocks, photo uploads, crops and GIPHY stickers.
